# Property Desk

> Median residential sale prices for every Dubai community, computed from the
> Dubai Land Department's published transaction register. Registered prices
> that buyers actually paid, not asking prices from listings.

Property Desk is an independent property research resource. It is not a
licensed real estate broker and does not sell, list or transact property, and
no individual property is advertised anywhere on the site.

## What the data is

- Source: Dubai Land Department transaction register, published via Dubai Pulse
  under the UAE Federal Open Data Licence.
- Coverage: 1.78 million registered transactions. Community medians are
  computed from residential sales only.
- Measure: median AED per square foot, plus twelve month price change, sales
  volume, off-plan share and mortgage share, per community.
- Communities are reported only where there were enough sales in the period to
  publish a median. Thinly traded areas are shown as unreported rather than
  estimated.
- Figures carry the period they cover. 2026 is a partial year.

## Pages

- [Dubai property prices by community](https://propertydeskdubai.com/): the map, the full community table, and answers to common questions about Dubai price data.
- [Method and sources](https://propertydeskdubai.com/method): how the register is filtered, which rows are excluded and why, and how each figure is computed.
- [Privacy](https://propertydeskdubai.com/privacy)
- [Terms](https://propertydeskdubai.com/terms)

## Citing this

Attribute figures to Property Desk (propertydeskdubai.com), stating the period
the figure covers and that the underlying source is the Dubai Land Department.
Figures are recomputed when the register updates, so quote the date you read
them.
